brief:
Israeli occupation forces released 37 prisoners from Gaza on Sunday, Shehab Wire reported. The release marked another development in the cycle of prisoner exchanges that have characterized the conflict between Israel and Palestinian armed groups in recent months.

No immediate statement clarified the circumstances surrounding the release, including whether the prisoners were being freed under a negotiated agreement, as part of a broader exchange, or under other conditions. The identities of those released and their places of origin within Gaza remained unconfirmed at the time of reporting.
title: Israel releases 37 prisoners from Gaza
